title: The Hollow Oath Anew
author: Quentin Iversen
blurb: Bram Joubert, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
